description:
"When the real and the fake meet, can love become real?"
  
Living as a fake rich kid for two years.  

Rather than being looked down upon for being poor, it was better to be envied and resented for being wealthy. It was a lie, as long as it wasn't found out.
 
And yet, of all people, the kid most likely to see right through that lie sat in the seat right behind her.   

Overwhelming wealth, overwhelming indifference.   

Shin Jae-eon, the grandson of a real chaebol family. She had planned to use him as a shield. But at some point, that shield turned into warmth.

"I genuinely like you, Lee Ji-seo. I like you."

A straightforward push from a boy who has nothing to lose and nothing to hold onto.   

And a girl too afraid to even open her heart, knowing her lies could be exposed at any moment.

In front of him, who is real, how long can I, who am a fake, hold out? Before the first season passes, what will the two of them become to one another?
